user.title: SunSpec connection
user.description: How is the SunSpec device connected?

tcp.title: SunSpec Modbus TCP connection
tcp.description: Enter the device host, port, and Unit ID to connect to your SunSpec device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device, or of its Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the device, usually 502.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the device, also called slave ID. Most SMA inverters use 126 for SunSpec.

serial.title: SunSpec Modbus RTU connection
serial.description: Enter the serial port, such as /dev/ttyUSB0, its baud rate and parity, and the Unit ID of your SunSpec device.

data_description.device: Serial port of the RS485 adapter, such as /dev/ttyUSB0.
data_description.baudrate: Speed set on the device, such as 9600.
data_description.parity: Parity set on the device; data bits are always 8 and stop bits 1.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the device, also called slave ID. Most SMA inverters use 126 for SunSpec.

settings.title: Sensor options
settings.description: Enter an optional prefix for sensor names and select any additional SunSpec models (data registers) you would like to create sensors for. This can also be changed later in the component configuration.

data_description.prefix: Text put in front of every sensor name, to tell devices apart.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between reads of the device.

error.connection: Failed to connect, check the connection settings
error.device_error: Connection reached the device, but initialization failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Check that the device is online and responding on the configured host, port, and Unit ID.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up. Its entry now uses the connection entered here.

host_options.title: SunSpec Modbus TCP connection
host_options.description: Update the device host, port, and Unit ID for this SunSpec connection.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device, or of its Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the device, usually 502.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the device, also called slave ID. Most SMA inverters use 126 for SunSpec.

data_description.parity: Parity set on the device; data bits are always 8 and stop bits 1.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit ID of the device, also called slave ID. Most SMA inverters use 126 for SunSpec.

model_options.title: Device Options
model_options.description: Select what SunSpec models (data registers) you would like to create sensors for.

data_description.prefix: Text put in front of every sensor name, to tell devices apart.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between reads of each model without its own interval below.

model_intervals.name: Poll interval per model
model_intervals.description: Seconds between reads of a model. A model left empty is read at the scan interval.
